lines.zh: 我迈着长腿走，姿态很从容。
lines.en: I walk with long strides, quite unhurried.

lines.zh: 吸收了那小子，走路都稳了。
lines.en: After absorbing that boy, even my walk steadied.

lines.zh: 我低头看路，一路都是断墙。
lines.en: I look down the road; broken walls all along it.
My shadow is taller than the wall.

lines.zh: 我脚尖点地，身体轻轻飘起。
lines.en: I touch a toe to the ground and float up.
I walk the scorched earth, taking my time.

lines.zh: 每迈一步，腰带都晃一下。
lines.en: Each stride swings my belt.
My speech comes clearly now too.

lines.zh: 我绕着倒塌的塔走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the fallen tower once.
The dust parts around my feet.
I'm in no hurry, and neither should you be.

lines.zh: 我迈过长腿，影子压过断墙。
lines.en: My long legs stride and my shadow spills over broken walls.
I raise a hand and study it.

lines.zh: 那孩子的力量，我借得不错。
lines.en: The boy's power borrows well.
I close my fist slowly until my knuckles whiten.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，像在看一场戏。
lines.en: I look up at the sky as if watching a play.
Standing still, I listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 这具身体里住着好几个人。
lines.en: Several people live inside this body.
I smooth the tendrils at my brow.

lines.zh: 有礼貌地等，也是一种威胁。
lines.en: Waiting politely is a kind of threat too.
I'm not hungry; I simply want to hit something.

lines.zh: 呼吸平稳，气在身体里转。
lines.en: Breathing easy, ki moves through me.

lines.zh: 我歪头，想了想怎么拆你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and consider how to take you apart.
The quiet makes me want to break it.

lines.zh: 我看了看自己的腰带，紧了。
lines.en: I check my belt; it's tight.
I smile, and it's a courteous smile.
Hello there. I'm Buu.
You look a little tense.
Let's talk first, then fight.
Your ki isn't bad. Worth a look.
I look down at you, quite politely.

lines.zh: 你认识那个叫悟饭的吗？
lines.en: Do you know someone called Gohan?

lines.zh: 我现在讲道理了，你运气好。
lines.en: I reason things out now. Lucky you.
Take your hand off that sword.

lines.zh: 我现在会讲道理，先听我说。
lines.en: I'm reasonable now — hear me out first.

lines.zh: 我想知道你能撑到第几下。
lines.en: I'd like to know at which blow you break.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，你别跟着笑。
lines.en: When I smile, don't smile back.

lines.zh: 你很像我认识的一个人。
lines.en: You remind me of someone I knew.

lines.zh: 这身衣服不错，可惜会破。
lines.en: Nice clothes. A shame they'll tear.

lines.zh: 我说话很慢，你要听清楚。
lines.en: I speak slowly. Listen carefully.
You still have a chance to leave. Take it now.

lines.zh: 我只是在打量你，仅此而已。
lines.en: I'm merely sizing you up. Nothing more.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在往后退，身体却没动。
lines.en: Your eyes retreat while your body stays.
Enough. I've seen what I need.
You're right. I was careless.

lines.zh: 这一下不深，但很有礼貌。
lines.en: Not deep, but delivered with manners.
I step back and reassess you.
It hurts, certainly. I won't deny it.
Blood drips off my chin.
You keep your head better than I thought.

lines.zh: 这具身体在提醒我别小看你。
lines.en: This body is telling me not to underestimate you.
I let out a breath and steady myself.

lines.zh: 我会记住这一下的分量。
lines.en: I'll remember the weight of that blow.
It seems I should get serious.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我没兴趣。
lines.en: That thing in your hand doesn't interest me.

lines.zh: 不过你要是递过来，我会接着。
lines.en: But if you offer it, I'll take it.
I'm not greedy for food; I'm greedy for power.
Hold it higher so I can see.

lines.zh: 这东西里的气，有点意思。
lines.en: The ki in this is interesting.
I'm reaching. You may refuse.

lines.zh: 你靠近的每一步，我都记着。
lines.en: I note every step you take closer.
Give it here and I'll leave you intact.
I stare at it without blinking.
You do know your manners.
You bumped me. I apologize.
Next time, though, I'll bump back.
I step back half a pace, politely.
Your head only reaches my waist.
Don't walk so close. I dislike it.
That bump hurt you too, didn't it.
I steady you with one hand. Stand firm.
The road is long. Walk slowly.
You're pressing on my belt.
This flesh stretches and shrinks.

lines.zh: 我这里挤了好几个人，不方便。
lines.en: It's crowded in here. Inconvenient.
A polite refusal. Don't take offense.
I'm only interested in the strong.
Beat me, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 我吸收了别人，也变得挑剔了。
lines.en: Having absorbed others, I've grown particular.
This body already has company inside.
Would you like to move in too?
Relax. I'm only joking.
I don't know gentleness, and I learn it slowly.
Stand further off. You're too close.
I bend and pick it up, steady.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，归先到的人。
lines.en: What's on the ground goes to whoever's first.

lines.zh: 我看了看，随手收进腰带。
lines.en: I glance at it and tuck it in my belt.
This little thing is interesting.

lines.zh: 我不用手，气就把它托起来了。
lines.en: No hands needed; ki lifts it.
Keep it. It'll serve some purpose.
I weigh it; laughably light.

lines.zh: 这是你的？现在是我的了。
lines.en: Was this yours? It's mine now.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前，慢慢看。
lines.en: I hold it up and look at it slowly.
Picking things up is a kind of courtesy.
You moved, so I'll begin.

lines.zh: 你的气稳，可惜还差一截。
lines.en: Your ki is steady, but still a notch short.

lines.zh: 你的气很稳，可惜不够强。
lines.en: Your ki is steady, but not strong enough.
Locking on was easy.
Courtesy first, force after. I did warn you.
Seeing you retreat puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 你藏在石后，我早看见了。
lines.en: You hide behind that rock — I saw you anyway.
I'll use the boy's techniques.
Where have you hidden your companions?

lines.zh: 别费心找退路了，我看得见。
lines.en: Don't bother finding an exit; I can see them all.
You've started to sweat.
When my hand rises, you should understand.
I won't drag this out.
Hello, prey.

lines.zh: 我看着你的脚步，一步都没漏。
lines.en: I've watched your steps; not one missed.
Right. This is far enough.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑过去，很静。
lines.en: I slide low and quiet.

lines.zh: 你的左手在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Your left hand is shaking. I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧后，你没察觉。
lines.en: I circle to your rear flank unobserved.
I wait for the moment you change your breath.

lines.zh: 这一步之后，你就没退路了。
lines.en: After this step you'll have no retreat.
I stand on scorched earth in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你换手那一下，我记住了。
lines.en: I noted the moment you switched hands.

lines.zh: 气在我掌中聚起来，很安静。
lines.en: Ki gathers in my palm, quietly.
The more you retreat, the closer I get.
One opening is all I need.
That wall behind you won't hold.
I saw you switch hands.
I'll stop here and let you move first.
Your ki leaks a little every time you swing.
A pity. You chose the wrong direction.

lines.zh: 你出手之前，我先动半个身位。
lines.en: I shift half a body before you even swing.
I'll prepare this one properly.

lines.zh: 我已经算好了你的距离。
lines.en: I've already measured your distance.
Majin fist, from the side.
My arm stretches and hits your back.
Meteor combination — four blows without pause.

lines.zh: 龟派气功，我借来的招式。
lines.en: Kamehameha. A borrowed technique.
Masenko. Don't look straight at it.
The ki wave pushes you along.
First, three small ki blasts.

lines.zh: 我肘击你的锁骨，听见响声。
lines.en: My elbow finds your collarbone; I hear it.
Your pauldron flies off.
I grab you and press you into the ground.

lines.zh: 龟派气功是我借来的招式。
lines.en: The Kamehameha is a technique I borrowed.
You landed a hit. Too shallow, though.
I stepped back out of courtesy.
The Masenko grazes your shoulder.
My arms stretch a long way.
It's over. Don't force it.

lines.zh: 我落地时很轻，几乎没声音。
lines.en: I land very lightly, almost silently.

lines.zh: 这具身体比上次更完整。
lines.en: This body is more complete than before.

lines.zh: 我站直，先整理了一下腰带。
lines.en: I stand up and adjust my belt first.
The air carries a strong smell.

lines.zh: 我把两只手举到眼前看了看。
lines.en: I raise both hands and look them over.
The boy's memories are still here.
I step out, my tread sure.
It's quiet here. I like quiet.

lines.zh: 我呼吸了一次，气就满了。
lines.en: One breath and my ki is full.

lines.zh: 光线照在我身上，我没躲。
lines.en: The light falls on me; I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，等一个对手。
lines.en: I stand here waiting for an opponent.
Well then. I've arrived.
A fine place for a duel.
I kick the rubble aside.
Hungry again. How tiresome.

lines.zh: 我吸收了悟饭，身子变了样。
lines.en: I absorbed Gohan and changed shape.
Let's begin. Do your best.
I hold my ki in check and take a look first.

lines.zh: 火苗在皮肤上滑开，不疼。
lines.en: Flame slides off my skin without pain.

lines.zh: 我落地时把石阶压碎了。
lines.en: I press the stone steps to powder on landing.
Underwater I can't speak clearly.
Blast smoke makes me narrow my eyes.
An arrow buries itself in my arm.

lines.zh: 这力量让我体内的气乱了。
lines.en: This force scrambles the ki inside me.
Too long empty and my ki thins.

lines.zh: 雷落在肩上，我只觉得麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shoulder; I only feel numb.

lines.zh: 虚空很安静，安静得不像话。
lines.en: The void is quiet. Unreasonably quiet.
